components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main commerce CTA: add to cart, checkout, B2B submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; font-size: clamp(14px, calc(13.33px + 0.208vw), 16px); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; line-height: 1; color: #ffffff; background: #b73337; border: 1.5px solid #b73337; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(183, 51, 55, 0.24); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8e2629; border-color: #8e2629; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(183, 51, 55, 0.36); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8e2629; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: PDP Two-Column Shell
components.description: Desktop PDP: gallery 54% + buy-box 46% inside 1440px centered shell.
components.html:
Manete Embreagem CG Titan

CÓD: 6000 · Em estoque
components.css: .ds-pdp-shell { max-width: 1440px; margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: 20px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-pdp-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; align-items: flex-start; gap: clamp(24px, 2.5vw, 40px); width: 100%; } .ds-pdp-col { min-width: 0; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-pdp-col--media { flex: 1 1 54%; max-width: 54%; } .ds-pdp-col--info { flex: 1 1 46%; max-width: 46%; } .ds-pdp-media { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; background: #f7f7f7; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-pdp-buybox { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; width: 100%; } .ds-pdp-title { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(18px, calc(17.33px + 0.208vw), 20px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; color: #333333; } .ds-pdp-meta { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(14px, calc(13.33px + 0.208vw), 16px); color: #666666; } @media (max-width: 991px) { .ds-pdp-row { flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; } .ds-pdp-col--media, .ds-pdp-col--info { flex: 1 1 100%; max-width: 100%; } }

components.name: B2B Hero Trust Item
components.description: Home B2B diferencial: 48px icon + label. Grid 3 col ≥768px, stack mobile.
components.html: • CNPJ · Araraquara, SP
components.css: .ds-hero-trust-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 24px; list-style: none; margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 0; } .ds-hero-trust-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 24px 16px; text-align: center; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-hero-trust-icon { display: block; width: 48px; height: 48px; flex: 0 0 48px; color: #b73337; } .ds-hero-trust-text { font-size: clamp(12px, calc(11.33px + 0.208vw), 14px); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; color: #333333; max-width: 22ch; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-hero-trust-strip { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 16px; } }

components.name: Shelf Carousel Nav
components.css: .ds-shelf-nav { display: flex; gap: 10px; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-shelf-nav-btn { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; color: #333333; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-shelf-nav-btn:hover { background: #b73337; border-color: #b73337; color: #ffffff; } .ds-shelf-nav-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b73337; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Standard PLP/home product tile: white surface, soft border.
components.css: .ds-product-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-product-card__thumb { aspect-ratio: 1; background: #f7f7f7; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-product-card__title { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(14px, calc(13.33px + 0.208vw), 16px); font-weight: 600; color: #333333; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-product-card__price { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(14px, calc(13.33px + 0.208vw), 16px); font-weight: 700; color: #b73337; }

narrative.overview: B2B motorcycle parts Magento storefront on AWA_Custom/ayo_home5_child. Restrained AWA red (#b73337), 8px spacing, fluid clamp() typography, catalog axis 1440px. LESS-first via _extend.less; legacy async bundles for final-wins only.

rules.name: The LESS-First Law
rules.body: Express durable styling in LESS partials imported from _extend.less. Legacy async bundles are for final-wins retirement or production hotfixes only.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: AWA red appears on primary actions, active navigation, carousel progress, and focus. It must not flood backgrounds.

rules.name: The No-Hex-in-Theme Rule
rules.body: Use @awa-* or var(--awa-*) in LESS; never new hardcoded hex in partials.

rules.name: The PDP Flex Rule
rules.body: Never set display: grid on .main-detail > .row. Desktop PDP uses flex 54/46 with Bootstrap pseudos disabled.

rules.name: The Fluid Type Rule
rules.body: Prefer var(--awa-fs-*) or _design-system mixins over fixed px font sizes.

rules.name: The Flat Catalog Rule
rules.body: Product grids stay flat at rest; shadows only on interaction.

dos: Do add final-wins partials after _awa-consolidated.less when needed
Do use @awa-page-catalog (1440px) for PDP/PLP shell alignment
Do use @awa-s-1 through @awa-s-9 for structural spacing
Do validate after static-content deploy for ayo_home5_child
donts: Don't create new standalone .css files in web/css/ for routine visual work
Don't edit HTML, PHP, or XML for visual-token-only tasks
Don't edit Rokanthemes or parent theme
Don't use hardcoded hex in LESS
Don't use colored side-stripe borders on cards
Don't apply glassmorphism, gradient text, or hero-metric templates
Don't add bounce or elastic easing
